step 1, front: Lay the front shell face down.
step 2, insert: goes in straight (it would come off towards the back). Press the four inserts into the posts with a soldering iron (220 °C for PETG), flush with the posts' ends.
step 3, cap: goes in straight (it would come off towards the back). Drop the ten caps into their holes, stems down.

step 4, board: goes in straight (it would come off towards the back). Lower the board onto the posts, panel down: the on/off lever and the USB-C socket slide into their openings. Then put the cells in, plus towards the + on the board.
step 5, back: goes in straight (it would come off towards the back). Lower the back shell on: the module's antenna goes into the pocket at the top edge.
step 6, screw: goes in straight (it would come off towards the back). Four screws from the back. Stop when a head seats: more torque only pulls the insert.
